Welcome! I’m Anna Higgs, a Neuromuscular Massage Therapist with 6+ years of clinical experience in Colorado.

Massage therapy is an active, essential tool for neuro-rehabilitation, post-surgery recovery, injury management, and long-term wellness. On this channel, I break down specialized bodywork modalities—including neuromuscular therapy, myofascial release, trigger point release, IASTM, and lymphatic drainage—to help you relieve pain, restore mobility, and support your overall health.

My goal is to create a calm, welcoming space where you can learn, heal, and feel restored.

📍 Fountain Chiropractic & Wellness | Fountain, CO

📞 Call to Book: (719) 799-6555

🌐 Website: fountainchiropractor.com
